rootCauseChain: redactConnectionString()'s own try/catch caught a URL parse failure and printed the safe fallback - databaseUrl was not a valid URL string at this point
Actual crash traced to node_modules/pg-connection-string/index.js:10 - 'if (str.charAt(0) === "/") {' - assumes str is a String
Traced backward to parseArgs() in migrate-sqlite-to-postgres.js: if the argv token following a flag is missing or looks like another flag, the value defaults to boolean true, not a string

This triggers whenever a connection string isn't quoted safely in the shell - an unquoted '&' in a Neon URL's query string (e.g. '&channel_binding=require') is bash's background-job operator and silently truncates the argument
databaseUrl === true (boolean) is truthy, passed every falsy check, reached new pg.Client({connectionString: true}), crashed 3 dependency layers down
